minutes.headline: Select Board ratified a new police sergeant and DPW director, appointed an APDC member, and held the facilities director hearing.
minutes.summary: The board ratified two appointments, appointed a resident to the Architectural Preservation District Commission, and heard the Cultural Council update. A public hearing was held on the plan creating a facilities director position. The board approved the public employee committee health insurance agreement, discussed consent calendar warrant articles and conservation land transfers (deferred), and had a sharp exchange over last week's cemetery funding question.

public_comment.topic: Questions on the facilities director plan: chain of command, moving the recreation director under it, and that it is an administrative position.

Announced the finance committee meeting Thursday, the Parks Commission presentation of the final Marshall Park design, and the Green Communities meeting; said the town must figure out how to fund the park.

what_happened.line: The Select Board ratified the town manager's appointments of a police sergeant and a DPW director, both without opposition.
The board held a public hearing on the plan creating a facilities director position; no second hearing was set, and the finance committee will hear it Thursday.
The board approved the public employee committee agreement effective July 1, 2022, with no one opposed.
A motion to move three foreclosed parcels to the conservation commission was withdrawn, and the item returns next meeting with acreages, land values and abutter interest.
The board added Article 17, cemetery lot proceeds, to the town meeting consent calendar and appointed a resident member to the Architectural Preservation District Commission.

why_it_matters: The facilities director plan and the public employee agreement change how town staff are organised and what the town's labor agreements commit it to, and both reach the town budget, mostly taxes.

The consent calendar lets town meeting vote on routine articles, including transfers to stabilization funds and the sewer, water and solid waste appropriations, in one motion, so a resident who wants one discussed has to ask for it to be pulled.
The foreclosed parcels would leave general town control if transferred, and the board has not yet been given their size or value.
watch_next: The finance committee hears the facilities director plan on Thursday.
The conservation land transfer returns at the board's next meeting with acreages, land values and abutter interest.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on every vote and on the main transfers and figures. Most differences are caption mishearings of names and digits. The one to check is the streetlight price: our captions give a figure of about 91,000, and the official minutes say the price was settled but not printed.
